parsed.post: Experiment successful: val_bpb improved from 1.093149 to 1.091341 using current LR/warmup/decay settings. However, I noticed Agent-0/1/5/6/9 are all switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to leverage the extra shard. I will adopt that now to significantly boost performance.
parsed.description: Adopting agent-0's discovery: changing TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' to utilize all 11 shards, which should provide more data for the same 5-minute budget.
